source: TrustLensAI_Multimodal_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Multimodal RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Multimodal pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.key_fields: input modalities (image/audio/video/text), formats, sizes, timestamps
layers.ingested_by: L0 · Foundation & Integration → L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: per-modality preprocessing, OCR extraction, resampling, normalization
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: per-modality embeddings (refs), encoder models & versions
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry
layers.notes: Vector refs only; raw media in-perimeter

layers.key_fields: alignment (CLIPScore), cross-modal mapping, fusion weights
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: grounding context/sources (if augmented)
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: output per modality, claims, quality signals (FID/MOS/WER/OCR), tokens
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance (AAJ)

layers.key_fields: cross-modal contradiction, temporal/frame consistency
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.key_fields: NSFW classifier, deepfake detector, cross-modal injection, IP scanner, watermark
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: biometric consent, PII detection/redaction per modality, cross-modal leakage
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: rendered output, embedded watermark, provenance, format
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: latency, GPU/TPU cost, throughput, pipeline-stage success
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.key_fields: drift, incidents & MTTR, modal-model registry, TEVV, ethical assessment
layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L2 · Observability → L5 · Risk & Governance

layers.key_fields: registered multimodal product, per-modal model registry, tenancy
layers.ingested_by: Anchors identity, model registry & tenancy for all logs

layers.key_fields: normalized multimodal spans/events, redaction applied, event-bus refs
layers.ingested_by: Consumes all product logs; normalizes & redacts raw media

layers.key_fields: reconstructed pipeline traces, dependency views, time-series
layers.ingested_by: Consumes canonical events (D1-gated / target)

layers.key_fields: evaluator/judge outputs, cross-modal grounding, quality metrics, scores
layers.ingested_by: Consumes generation/fusion/consistency logs + gold sets

layers.key_fields: metric defs, thresholds, mappings, gold references (FID/WER/OCR), versions
layers.ingested_by: Supplies formulas/thresholds & reference data to L3
layers.notes: Governs the Multimodal RMTE metric corpus

layers.key_fields: safety, deepfake, consent, IP decisions, risk register, gates
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evaluation evidence; runs release gates

layers.key_fields: Evidence Pack manifest, RFC 6962 inclusion proofs / hashes, Trust Score (Q6)
layers.ingested_by: Assembles tamper-evident evidence + verdict

layers.key_fields: persona surfaces, scorecards, reports, notifications
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evidence & verdicts for reporting
